limitations: No source sampled SEAMLESS passwords; no acquired ciphertext, cracking experiment, production replay or calibrated enterprise risk probability.

The target CDF envelope, service mixture, manual-service transfer, rank-unit mapping and 95% conditional completion floor are explicit unadopted scenario assumptions. Primary sources do not validate these transfers or chosen weights.
Printed rounding allowance is not a statistical confidence interval, sampling-error bound or transfer-error bound.
Actual natural-password snapshot-only cases stay UNRATED_NO_BASIS until an explicit appropriate population and compatible work model is reviewed.
Recovery numeric review cannot authorize request/activation/WinRM intervals on roasting histories. Current reset-history adoption is insufficient.
No changes to structural edges, semantic prerequisites, known-FALSE/unknown behavior, immutable historical artifacts or B-owned search/UI/consumer.
No measured full-path/production coverage gain claimed; B release and frozen-cohort replay remain required.

All profiles are reference scenarios, not a selected SEAMLESS product baseline. Choosing a supported deployment population requires a separate explicit applicability decision; source endpoints or the illustrative service mixture alone do not establish representativeness.

A uniform generator does not imply a uniform posterior after acquisition/full history. The declared posterior assumption requires separate B review and exact history/information/selection checks before any native binding.

Wide-cap upper is a hypothetical loose mathematical enclosure, not demonstrated achievable work in the 20h deadline. Separate mode-specific resource evidence is required before operational interpretation or numeric adoption.
